papers.title: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
papers.summary: Vidu S2 introduces real-time interactive avatar and video editing models that support high-resolution spatial video generation and dynamic reference updates.

papers.title: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
papers.summary: Atria Dawn Preview is a foundation agentic language model trained through verified tool interactions that achieves strong benchmark results and demonstrates a shift toward human-AI project-level collaboration in scientific research.

papers.title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
papers.summary: ZGCM-1 is a 7B open foundation model that combines internal reasoning with external tool use, trained via efficient architecture-system co-design, progressive long-context scaling, and autonomous agent workflows to achieve strong reasoning and efficiency.

papers.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
papers.summary: Dream-RSI enables scalable recursive self-improvement by using historical discovery replay to evaluate exploration policies offline, reducing costly online evaluations.

papers.title: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
papers.summary: PhysBrain 1.5 unifies physical environment understanding, action generation, and future state prediction via joint autoregressive training on discrete vision-language, motion, and visual target sequences, achieving state-of-the-art open-source embodied performance.
